page.overview:
What is Five Nights at Freddy's 4?

, originally named Five Nights at Freddy's 4: The Final Chapter during development and abbreviated as FNaF4, is an independent point-and-click sit-and-survive horror game developed and published by Scottgames, LLC, which released on July 23, 2015, for Windows, as the fourth installment in the Five Nights at Freddy's series. The game was ported to Android on July 25, 2015, Amazon Fire OS on July 26, 2015, and iOS on August 3, 2015.

Scottgames would partner with Clickteam LLC in 2018 to deliver HD remastered ports to all major consoles and update the mobile ports. The Xbox port would release on November 28, 2019, and on the PlayStation and Nintendo Switch on November 29, 2019. The mobile updates were released on January 16, 2020, for Android and iOS. These ports/updates would fix bugs, remove copyrighted material, and add a subtitles and cheats menu.

This time, the terror has followed you home.

In this last chapter of the Five Nights at Freddy's original story, you must once again defend yourself against Freddy Fazbear, Chica, Bonnie, Foxy, and even worse things that lurk in the shadows. Playing as a child whose role is yet unknown, you must safeguard yourself until 6am by watching the doors, as well as warding off unwanted creatures that may venture into your closet or onto the bed behind you.
